$comment: The in-app feature explainer: what each part of AgencyOS is for and how to use it. Every item in the sidebar must have an entry here (checked by installer/launcher/test/changelog.test.mjs). Keep it honest: say what a feature needs and what it does not do.

groups.title: Create and approve
groups.blurb: From a client's brief to an ad that is approved and ready to send.

groups.title: Deliver
groups.blurb: Send approved ads to Telegram chats that have authorized you, and see what happened.

groups.title: Grow
groups.blurb: Keep leads, knowledge and invoices next to the campaigns.

groups.title: Social scheduler
groups.blurb: Plan posts for social networks you connect. Separate from Telegram campaigns.

groups.title: AI and personal
groups.blurb: Your assistant, search, look and where your files live.

groups.title: Team
groups.blurb: For agencies where more than one person works in AgencyOS.

features.title: Dashboard
features.summary: Your starting point. It shows what needs you first, then how the work is going.
steps: Open Dashboard from the sidebar.
Read “What needs you”: approvals waiting, deliveries that failed, destinations that disconnected. Click a row to go straight to it.
Check the cards for active clients, campaigns in flight and authorized destinations.
If a red or amber banner appears, it names what is not set up yet (for example no Telegram bot token) and how to fix it.
tips: “All clear” means nothing is waiting on you.

features.title: Clients
features.summary: The companies you run ads for. Every campaign belongs to a client.
steps: Open Clients and choose Add client.
Enter the company and a contact. Only the name is required.
Open a client to see its campaigns and edit its details.
A client with live campaigns cannot be deleted: pause or finish the campaigns first.

features.title: Campaigns
features.summary: Write an ad, see exactly how it will look in Telegram, choose where it goes and when.
steps: Open Campaigns and choose New campaign, then pick the client.
Write the title and body. The preview on the side is the real message that will be sent, and it names any limit you are over.
Optional: press Suggest copy to get three headlines, bodies and calls to action from your AI provider. Edit freely; you decide what is used.
Add a link and button text if you want tracked clicks.
Choose the authorized Telegram destinations and a start time.
Submit for review. Nothing is sent until it is approved.
needs: At least one authorized destination before you can schedule (see Telegram).
tips: Press Ctrl+K and type a campaign name to jump to it.

features.title: Approvals
features.summary: The inbox for ads waiting for a second pair of eyes.
steps: Open Approvals to see campaigns submitted for review.
Open one, read the preview, then Approve or Send back with a note.
After approval the content is frozen. To change it, reopen the campaign, which voids the approval.
Owners and admins can approve their own work; that is recorded in the audit trail.

features.title: Telegram destinations
features.summary: The chats and channels AgencyOS may post to. A chat only counts once its administrator has authorized it.
steps: Press Connect a Telegram bot on the Dashboard (or use the tray icon, then Status and settings) and paste your bot token from @BotFather.
Open Telegram in AgencyOS and choose Connect a group or channel. You get a one-time code.
Add the bot to that chat, then a chat administrator sends /authorize and the code in the chat.
The destination turns active. Anyone can revoke it with /revoke, and it expires after a year unless renewed.
If the bot is removed or loses permission, the destination is paused and its queued posts wait.
needs: A chat administrator who agrees to authorize.
tips: AgencyOS does not join groups, collect members or add people. It only posts where it was invited and authorized.

features.title: Connected accounts
features.summary: Which platforms are connected and what each can do.
steps: Open Connected accounts to see the platforms and their capabilities.
Telegram campaigns are delivered from Telegram destinations. Other networks are for the social scheduler.
A campaign that only has social destinations is refused at submit, and the composer tells you so.

features.title: Reports
features.summary: What was delivered, what failed and why, by day, campaign and destination.
steps: Open Reports and choose the period.
Read delivered, failed, paused, queued and needs-check counts and the delivery rate.
Use Export CSV, or Print or save as PDF, for a copy to share.
A job marked Needs check was interrupted mid-send. AgencyOS never resends it on its own, so check the chat first.
tips: Numbers come from stored send results and tracked-link clicks. Impressions and reach are not shown because there is no verified source for them.

features.title: Sales pipeline
features.summary: Deals from first contact to won or lost.
steps: Open Sales pipeline and add a deal with a contact and, optionally, a value.
Move it through Prospect, Contacted, Proposal sent, then Won or Lost (a lost deal needs a reason).
Convert a won deal into a client once.

features.title: Knowledge base
features.summary: Notes and documents you add yourself, searchable by keywords and, once the local AI is ready, by meaning.
steps: Open Knowledge base and add a document.
Confirm the source allowed you to collect it and that the people in it were told. This is required.
Search by keyword. When the local search model has finished downloading, results are also ranked by meaning.
tips: It holds what you add. AgencyOS does not scrape groups or harvest usernames.

features.title: Invoices
features.summary: Numbered invoices per client with payments recorded by hand.
steps: Open Invoices and create one for a client. Numbers run INV-year-number.
Record a payment when money arrives.
AgencyOS does not email invoices or take payments yet.

features.title: Calendar
features.summary: A week or month view for posts on social networks you connect.
steps: Open Calendar and choose Add channel to connect a network. Sign-in opens in your browser, as the network requires.
Click a time slot to write a post and schedule it.
Use Day, Week or Month to change the view.
tips: This is the original social scheduler. Telegram ads are made in Campaigns.

features.title: Media library
features.summary: Images and videos you upload once and reuse.
steps: Open Media library and upload files.
Pick them when you write a post.

features.title: Channel analytics
features.summary: How connected social channels are doing.
steps: Connect a channel in Calendar first.
Open Channel analytics and pick the channel and period.

features.title: Team and roles
features.summary: Who can do what: owner, admin, sales, campaign manager, editor, analyst and client.
steps: Open Team and roles and pick a person's role.
Role changes apply immediately and are recorded in the audit trail.
tips: Hidden in the desktop app, where one person uses AgencyOS.

features.title: Client portal
features.summary: What a client sees: only their own campaigns, to review and sign off.
steps: Give a person the Client role for one customer.
They sign in and see only that customer's campaigns, with Approve and Send back.
tips: Hidden in the desktop app, where one person uses AgencyOS.

features.title: Copilot and agent
features.summary: A side panel with two modes. Ask answers questions and writes drafts. Agent does the work: it looks things up in AgencyOS, drafts campaigns and proposes changes that you approve.
steps: Press Ctrl+J (⌘J on a Mac) or the sparkles button in the top bar.
Ask: type a question in plain words, for example “How do I get an ad approved?”. It explains and drafts; it changes nothing.
Agent: tell it what to do, for example “What needs my attention today?” or “Add a client called Nair Foods”. You see each look-up as it happens.

When the agent wants to change something (add a client, create or edit a draft campaign, choose its Telegram destinations, submit it for review) it shows exactly what will change. Nothing happens until you press Approve.
Stop it at any time with Stop. Every approved change is recorded in the audit trail under your name.
It uses the provider, model and thinking level you chose for “Copilot chat” or “Agent” in Settings → AI and Copilot.
needs: A working AI provider (the local model works out of the box once downloaded). Agents work best with a capable model; a small local model may not follow the agent’s format.
tips: The agent can never approve a campaign, schedule or send anything, delete anything, authorize a Telegram chat or change who may do what. Those stay with people.

features.title: Search
features.summary: Jump to any page, setting or campaign from the keyboard.
steps: Press Ctrl+K (⌘K on a Mac) anywhere.
Type a few letters, use ↑ ↓ and press Enter.

features.title: AI and Copilot settings
features.summary: Choose which AI answers, which model, and how hard it thinks.
steps: Open Settings → AI and Copilot.
Pick a provider. Local model needs nothing. Claude Code, Codex CLI and Antigravity CLI use the programs on this computer that you have already signed in to. APIs need your key.
Pick a model from the list. The list comes from the provider itself (the tool, your installed models, or your API account) and has a Refresh button; you can also type a model name.
Pick a thinking level. Only the levels that model supports are offered. Higher is slower and more careful; Auto leaves it to the provider.

Under “A different model for each job” you can choose another provider, model and thinking level for ad copy, text improvement, Copilot chat and the agent, for example a fast local model for copy and a stronger one for the agent. Each job has its own Test button.
Press Test. It says exactly what is wrong if something is missing.

Below, keep Claude Code, Codex CLI and Antigravity CLI up to date: AgencyOS runs each tool’s own update command once a day, or press Update now. Switch it off there if you prefer to update them yourself.
tips: Only owners and admins can change these settings.

features.title: Appearance
features.summary: Light, dark or follow your computer.
steps: Use the sun or moon button in the top bar for a quick switch.
Choose Light, Dark or System in the account menu or in Settings → Appearance.

features.title: Storage
features.summary: Where your database, uploads and AI models live, and how to move them.
steps: Open Settings → Storage to see both folders.
Choose Move and pick a new folder. AgencyOS stops, copies, checks the copy, switches and restarts.
The old copy is deleted only when you say so.
tips: Only available in the desktop app.
